description: Add per-eviction warn! logs to `evict_eligible()` in `helper/src/segment/buffer.rs` so the next B4 qualifying repro exposes exactly who emptied the ring, when, and under what eviction condition. T-040 deployed pin-time warn! logs (committed ring empty at save time) — they tell us the ring state at pin time but not what happened during eviction. This slice adds: (1) an entry warn! when evictions are about to run (pre-state snapshot: to_evict count, committed_len, bytes_on_disk, now_pts, window/cap thresholds); (2) a per-segment warn! inside the Ok(()) arm for each successfully removed segment (index, pts range, age_90k, trigger=age|disk_cap, byte_size, committed_len_after, segments_evicted, bytes_on_disk_after). Zero behavior changes. buffer.rs only. Additive logging only.
title: ISS-015 B4.1 per-eviction logging in buffer.rs
